question: How should mantra placement be employed in place of the mātṛkā placement?
premises: The mantra placement is to be employed.
It is employed in the place of the mātṛkā.
The mantra form ends with namas.
inference: One should employ the mantra placement ending with namas in place of the mātṛkā placement.
plain_english: One should employ the mantra placement, ending with namas, in place of the mātṛkā placement.
